notes: «أبي رضي الله عنه» is the compiler's father, a relation link (rule 7). The «9-4» before it is the report number.
«عمن حدثه من أصحابنا» is an unnamed gap (rule 8). «أبي عبد الله» inside the chain after «عن» is a narrator (owner ruling 2).
«سمعته يقول» refers back to أبي عبد الله and adds no link; «قال أمير المؤمنين» is the Imam speaking in the words after the chain (owner ruling 2).
